name: Chaos — January 5, 2005

date.source: The fed's own served broadcast dates itself "Wednesday January 5th, 2005" at Wings Stadium, Kalamazoo, Michigan.

notes: The fed's own weekly TV show, opening its 2005 run after a storyline USO tour. Josh Render defeats Brandon Walsh in his first singles match. Greg Martus defeats Dave "The Wasp" Wassic in his own first singles match, with an unseen assist from his tag partner Josh Render. Returning GM Bassel Noori ("B") then announces the fed's next PPV, "Chaos: Dissension" (15 January 2005, Van Andel Arena, Grand Rapids), headlined by a six-man match for the WWE Chaos Championship between reigning champion Eli Jimenez, DJ Finch, Brandon Walsh, Tony "The Man Beast" Lozon, a returning Jay Taylor, and an unnamed sixth entrant. The announcement is interrupted by a brawl: Eli Jimenez and DS Inc. (Josh Render, Greg Martus) attack B, until Tony Lozon and then Jay Taylor run in to even the odds; DJ Finch and Brandon Walsh ("The Rednecks") join the fray against B and Tony, until Jay Taylor's own return tips the numbers back, closing the show with B, Tony and Jay standing over Eli Jimenez.

matches.note: Render's first singles match, wrestling without his tag partner Greg Martus. Render reverses a spine buster into a DDT before finishing Walsh with The Dominator. Render wins by pinfall at 9:08.

Martus's first singles match. Wassic gains an edge with a dropkick that distracts the referee; Render (Martus's tag partner, fresh off his own win) enters unseen and clotheslines Wassic, then slides back out before Martus covers for the pin.
